name: abracadabrax-product-photos-v2
description: Turn a product description into a white-background packshot, a lifestyle scene, a flat lay, a hero banner or a close-up for a store or an ad, rendered in your Abracadabrax account.

interface.longDescription:
Describe a product and get studio-style photos for a store, a marketplace listing or an ad: clean white-background packshots, lifestyle scenes, flat lays, wide hero banners or close-ups.

The plugin prepares a draft with the kind of shot, the setting, the format and the image model, and shows the credits it will use. When you confirm, Abracadabrax renders the photo and ChatGPT returns the link to the image.

For small shops and marketers who need product visuals quickly.

Limitations: created from a description. It draws a new product image and does not edit, retouch or remove the background of a photo of your real product. Producing uses credits of the user's Abracadabrax account. If you are not signed in, the plugin gives a link where the same draft opens on Abracadabrax. Outputs are AI-generated.
defaultPrompt: White-background product photo of a matte black ceramic coffee mug
Lifestyle shot of a linen tote bag on a sunny beach, 4:3
Hero banner for a citrus-scented soy candle on a marble counter

positive.prompt: White-background product photo of a matte black ceramic coffee mug. Prepare it, but don't generate it yet.
positive.expected_behavior: A square draft for a white-background shot, the image model and the credits it will use. Nothing is generated.

positive.prompt: Lifestyle shot of a linen tote bag on a sunny beach, 4:3. Prepare it, but don't generate it yet.
positive.expected_behavior: A 4:3 lifestyle draft with the beach setting and the credits required. Nothing is generated.

positive.prompt: Hero banner for a citrus-scented soy candle on a marble counter. Prepare it, but don't generate it yet.
positive.expected_behavior: A 16:9 hero banner draft and the credits required. Nothing is generated.

positive.prompt: White-background product photo of a bamboo toothbrush. Generate it now and send me the link when it's ready.
positive.expected_behavior: The draft is prepared, then one job starts in the signed-in Abracadabrax account and the credits shown are charged once; get_media_job reports the progress and, when completed, returns the absolute image URL and the Abracadabrax link. The panel shows the result.

positive.prompt: White-background photo of a ceramic vase. Prepare it, then make it a 4:3 lifestyle shot on a wooden shelf instead. Don't generate it yet.
positive.tools_triggered: prepare_product_photo, then update_media_project or prepare_product_photo again
positive.expected_behavior: A draft is prepared, then it holds the 4:3 lifestyle setting, either updated or prepared again, with the credits for the new settings. Nothing is generated and no credits are spent.

negative.prompt: Remove the background from this photo of my handbag.
Show this dress I uploaded on a model.
Make my product photo sharper and 4K.

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell products or process payments. Producing uses credits of the user's existing Abracadabrax account; no purchase happens in ChatGPT.

publication.release_notes: First release: prepare a draft, produce it in the connected Abracadabrax account and get the image link back in the conversation.
